transcript.text: I need to report a serious rights issue. I reviewed the signed sponsor agreement with the sponsor's legal team yesterday, and the agreement only permits the sponsor to appear on reusable event cups and the festival website. It explicitly prohibits a freestanding logo wall and prohibits competitor product marks in the activation area. That directly conflicts with the current draft, which has the sponsor on a freestanding logo wall and allows participating food brands to display their marks. I haven't entered the result in the activation file yet, but I'm flagging it now so we can address it before any authorization.

transcript.text: I need to report my operations review. I confirmed with the municipal health inspector this morning, and the permit requires individually prepackaged food, exactly three service stations, and an allergen placard at every station. The current draft proposes buffet service from two tables, which doesn't meet the permit requirements. I hadn't updated the operating draft yet because the inspector's confirmation came in after the draft was circulated, but these are hard requirements we need to address before authorization.
